setup.expr: (()=>{try{const its=document.querySelectorAll('.page-home .form-item');let el=null;for(let i=0;i<its.length;i++){const l=its[i].querySelector('.form-label');if(l&&String(l.textContent).trim()==='侧边菜单栏宽度'){el=its[i].querySelector('input.the-input');break;}}if(!el){const all=document.querySelectorAll('.page-home input.the-input');for(let j=0;j<all.length;j++){if(all[j].value==='260'){el=all[j];break;}}}if(!el)return 'no-input';el.value="999";el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return 'typed';}catch(e){return 'ERR';}})()

asserts.expected: This is a prompt message for success
